body.cap: The InTheTech booth at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: At CES 2025, the world’s largest electronics exhibition in Las Vegas, Korean digital healthcare leader InTheTech (CEO Seung Ho Choun) waves by promoting its flagship solutions ‘EYAS’ and ‘COGPLAY’ to global audiences. The InTheTech booth has been bustling with visitors and industry representatives, highlighting the company’s growing presence in the global digital healthcare market. EYAS, a digital cognitive rehabilitation solution for individuals with mild cognitive impairment and ADHD, has been receiving significant attention for its innovative technology and utility.

EYAS is a digital therapeutic device rooted in cognitive and neuroscience, praised for its comprehensive approach to treating mild cognitive impairment and ADHD and preventing cognitive decline. Its core ‘EyeLink System’ integrates eye-tracking technology with evidence-based rehabilitation content to substantially improve focus and cognitive abilities. Through repetitive and continuous cognitive training, users can experience sustained improvement. Live demonstrations of EYAS at CES 2025 have garnered enthusiastic reactions from attendees. A representative from an international media outlet noted, “EYAS sets a new benchmark in digital healthcare and is poised to establish itself rapidly in the global market.”

body.cap: A visitor trying EYAS, which integrates eye-tracking technology with evidence-based rehabilitation content to improve focus and cognitive abilities | Photo by AVING News

body.x: InTheTech is leveraging CES 2025 to explore collaborative opportunities with medical industry stakeholders from regions with high healthcare demands, including North America, Malaysia, Australia, and Thailand. Having successfully entered markets such as India, Turkey, and Kazakhstan over the past two years, InTheTech is using this event to expand its network and accelerate its global market penetration. CEO Seung Ho Choun remarked, “CES is a pivotal platform for showcasing InTheTech’s globally recognized technology and creating new opportunities. By establishing partnerships in regions with pressing healthcare needs, we aim to deliver technology that improves lives.”

Also introduced at CES 2025 is the B2C platform COGPLAY, designed to enhance brain function at home. COGPLAY offers effective cognitive training solutions using evidence-based content, and it stands out with its user-friendly interface and personalized cognitive data management features. This platform significantly enhances healthcare accessibility by enabling use in medical facilities and everyday life.

body.cap: Demo of the EYAS digital therapeutic device and the B2C platform ‘COGPLAY’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: InTheTech bolstered its presence in the U.S. market through participation in the KIC Silicon Valley program before CES 2025. The program provided tailored incubation support, including local incorporation and FDA approval assistance, strengthening the company’s global capabilities. CEO Choun stated, “Following CES, we will focus on establishing professional care environments in global medical institutions with EYAS and developing home-based cognitive training systems through COGPLAY. Our next step is to head to Silicon Valley to advance our global expansion further.”
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
